# Wellocated

> Wellocated is a premium discovery platform that connects discerning world travelers and local explorers with the best-located brands, venues, and products.

Wellocated serves as a curated digital journal and directory, focusing on the intersection of quality and location. We help users "locate well"—finding where to obtain the finest products and experience the most unique venues across major international destinations. The platform bridges the gap between discovery and accessibility through a highly localized, multi-lingual interface.

The platform's core strength lies in its sophisticated content architecture, which provides rich, multi-dimensional profiles for venues and brands, supported by a "Discovery Journal" (Blog) that offers deep-dives into cultural and lifestyle trends. Every piece of content is natively localized for nine major European markets, ensuring a seamless experience for a global audience.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://wellocated.com): The gateway to curated discoveries, featuring featured brands and latest journal entries.
- [Discovery Journal](https://wellocated.com/en/blog): A rich repository of insights, stories, and deep-dives into premium lifestyle and locations.
- [Brands](https://wellocated.com/en/brand): Curated directory of premium brands, focused on their physical presence and accessibility.
- [Venues](https://wellocated.com/en/venue): Hand-picked locations and venues known for their exceptional quality and strategic location.

## Key Features

- [Localized Experience](https://wellocated.com): Full native support for 9 languages (EN, FR, DE, IT, ES, NL, PT, SV, DA), enabling truly global reach.
- [Smart Translation](https://wellocated.com): Integrated with DeepL and Microsoft Azure AI for high-fidelity, context-aware content synchronization.
- [SEO Optimized Architecture](https://wellocated.com/sitemap.xml): Unified canonical and hreflang structure across all localized routes, ensuring world-class search engine visibility.
